name: Nikita Banga
headline: Educational Psychologist | EdTech Specialist | Holistic Health & Wellbeing
major: Bachelor in Psychology and M.Sc. in Educational Psychology
summary:
Hello! I’m Nikita, an Educational Psychologist and E-learning Specialist at 'Learnesco', a company I founded. With a solid background in academic research in Psychology and Learning Sciences, coupled with hands-on experience in UX design, product development, and project management, I’m passionate about creating engaging and impactful online educational experiences using the latest tools and technologies. My diverse skill set bridges research and real-life applications, ensuring that every learning solution I design is evidence-based and user-centered.

I’m also building 'The Conscious Club' — a platform and community dedicated to supporting the holistic growth and transformation of individuals, empowering them towards realizing their full potential. For over 12 years, I’ve immersed myself in a wide range of Western and Eastern philosophies and practices; blending science, spirituality, and the creative arts to support my own growth and overcome challenges in different areas of life. Now, I'm sharing these insights, tools as well as unique practices I've crafted to help others on similar journeys. My goal is to foster a conscious community where people feel supported, celebrated, and inspired by one another.

In my free time, you can find me exploring the great outdoors and seeking new adventures. I’m deeply passionate about environmental sustainability and wildlife conservation, and with a growing interest in finance and impact investing, I aim to contribute to creating a better world for future generations.
